title: Maximum Sum With Exactly K Elements
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and an integer k, you must execute the following operation exactly k times to maximize your score: choose an element m from nums, remove it, add m + 1 to the array, and increase your score by m.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and an integer k, you must execute the following operation exactly k times to maximize your score: choose an element m from nums, remove it, add m + 1 to the array, and increase your score by m. Return the highest score achievable.
constraints: Repeat exactly k times: remove a chosen value m, add m+1 back, and increase the score by m.
Choose operations to maximize the total score.
hints: The currently largest value yields the best immediate score.
After choosing it, its replacement increases by one and remains at least as large as every untouched value.
Thus all k choices form largest, largest+1, ..., largest+k-1.
The exchange argument makes every smaller first choice no better, and the arithmetic-series formula sums the forced optimal sequence.
editorial: The exchange argument makes every smaller first choice no better, and the arithmetic-series formula sums the forced optimal sequence.

tests.explanation: Repeatedly choosing the current maximum scores five, six, and seven for total eighteen.
Choose a five and then its replacement six for total eleven.
